## What and why

## Evidence
- [ ] `python3 scripts/smoke_test.py` passes
- [ ] `pytest tests` passes (or explain)
- [ ] Any new number points to a committed results file and states scripted/learned and deterministic/stochastic
- [ ] Existing caveats (strike regime, smash unverified, no trained model qualifies) are still accurate

## Hygiene
- [ ] No videos/GIFs, zips, checkpoints, logs, raw mocap, or files over 5 MB
- [ ] New data is tagged, licensed and consented (see data contribution template)
- [ ] No claims implying a real player's data or endorsement
